description: Land Acquisition - Yakalla, Ibbagamwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose (proposed railway line). It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots, their boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena), this is only in his capacity to authorize the land acquisition under statutory powers, and the primary focus is entirely on land matters rather than government personnel or organizational changes.
